input_messages.content: Hi, I just placed an order with two watches, and I need to make some changes.
I don’t remember my email, but my name is Noah Ito and my zip code is 98187.
I don’t have the order ID handy. Can you look it up for me? It’s the most recent order with two watches.
First, I want to change the shipping address to my New York address. It’s the same one I used for another order.
I’d rather not say the address out loud, but yes, it’s the same New York address I used before. Please use that one.
Yes, that’s right. Go ahead and update it. Also, I want to change one of the watches—the silicone one—to a metal band instead. If there are color options, I’d like white.

Yes, that’s fine. Go ahead and make those changes. 

Also, I have another order with an air purifier and a speaker. I want to change the purifier to the large size with night mode, but I still want the HEPA filter.
I’m not sure about the order ID, but it’s the one with both an air purifier and a speaker. That’s the one I want to change.
Yes, please go ahead and make that change to the air purifier. You can use the same card for any price difference. I don’t need to change anything else.
Great, thanks for your help. That’s all I needed. ###STOP###
